movie1.title: Runner
movie1.description: A former soldier (Alan Ritchson) is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner (Owen Wilson) the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

movie2.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
movie2.description: "Oasis: Don't Look Back In Anger"charts Liam and Noel Gallagher's triumphant reunion tour, Oasis Live '25, one of the most anticipated rock 'n' roll comebacks of our time. The film is an unapologetically uplifting account of the biggest musical event of 2025, capturing the experience and emotions of the band and their fans across the world. The unique perspective includes rehearsal, backstage, and onstage access as well as the first joint interviews with Noel and Liam in over 20 years. Alongside the band's sold-out world tour, the film also explores the profound emotional impact of this phenomenal global cultural moment and what their music means to audiences and generations worldwide.

movie3.title: The Fix
movie3.description: THE FIX follows a group of war-torn CIA operators mentored by "Larry" (Liam Neeson) and led by "Tucker" (Zachary Levi) who, after their mission in Afghanistan goes tragically wrong, enter the heart of Tehran to earn redemption by pulling off a daring rescue.

movie4.title: Black Zombie
movie4.description: BLACK ZOMBIE digs beneath the blood-soaked spectacle of modern horror to uncover the zombie's buried and unsettling origins. Long before it became associated with flesh-eating ghouls, the zombie was a living metaphor for slavery: not a monster, but the ultimate victim of colonial power. A symbol of stolen agency was recast as an object of fear, while Black spiritual traditions were distorted, sensationalized, and erased. Director Maya Annik Bedward traces the evolution of the zombie from colonial Haiti to contemporary Hollywood, reconsidering iconic films like WHITE ZOMBIE, NIGHT OF THE LIVING DEAD, and THE SERPENT AND THE RAINBOW alongside archival footage, vérité scenes, and interviews with cultural historians, artists, and genre legends including Yves-Grégory Francois, Mambo Labelle Déesse, Slash, Tom Savini, and Zandashé Brown. Part cultural reckoning, part horror remix, BLACK ZOMBIE exposes how a figure born from enslavement, spiritual belief, and resistance was transformed into one of pop culture's most profitable monsters.

movie5.title: Don't Move
movie5.description: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one. Suspicion falls on Ricky (Russell "Russ" Vitale), the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse. Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move. It's up to Megan (Lyndsy Fonseca) to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

movie6.title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
movie6.description: In the Watts neighborhood of Los Angeles, twelve-year-old Lil Ant sees the world and his father the way all children should -- full of myth, wonder, and unwavering belief. If I Go Will They Miss Me is a breathtaking father-son story about imagination, family, and the grace we extend to the people we love.

movie7.title: Hanuman Ansh
movie7.description: Hanuman Ansh is a live action film that honors the extraordinary life and teachings of Neem Karoli Baba (Maharaj-ji), a spiritual master who touched millions of lives with his unconditional love and divine presence. Through powerful storytelling and authentic portrayal, we aim to share Baba's timeless wisdom with devotees across the globe, creating a film that inspires, uplifts, and connects people to the divine.

movie8.title: On a String
movie8.description: A Julliard-trained violist navigates the New York City freelance musician scene, playing gigs that often draw her into the personal lives of strangers, all while living in her oddball family's NYC apartment.

movie9.title: Kwaidan
movie9.description: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai (Rentarô Mikuni) marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden (Keiko Kishi), but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi (Katsuo Nakamura) is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts. An author (Osamu Takizawa) relates the story of a samurai who sees another warrior's reflection in his teacup.

movie10.title: Gator Face
movie10.description: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

movie11.title: First Timers
movie11.description: A documentary about the mental health challenges and struggles of first timers in the entertainment industry, exploring their early experiences, the obstacles they overcame and how they made it. A modern-day tale of dreams and aspirations set in the City of Angels.

movie12.title: The Condor Daughter
movie12.description: Clara is a teenager growing up in a small indigenous community high in the Andes. Her adoptive mother, a midwife who took her in as a baby, has taught her the ancient songs used to guide women through childbirth, melodies passed down for generations, believed to bring new life safely into the world. But while her voice carries on this tradition, her dreams lie elsewhere: she longs to leave the mountains behind and become a folkloric music star in the big city.

movie13.title: Misfit Mentor
movie13.description: Misfit Mentor is a moving music documentary about perseverance, fatherhood, and mentorship set in New Jersey and its historic punk/ska scene.

movie14.title: Mighty Mary
movie14.description: In 1995 Dawn Riley leads the first all-female sailing team to compete in the America's Cup.

movie15.title: A Marble in the Jar
movie15.description: Professional surfer Tatiana Weston-Webb rises to the top of women's surfing, as her coach and mentor, Greg Browning, battles ALS -- testing their resilience, friendship, and pursuit of purpose.

movie17.title: Pradhama Drishtya Kuttakkar
movie17.description: A woman constable joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

movie18.title: America America 2
movie18.description: A journey to Seattle brings Nudi face-to-face with her past. As old feelings resurface, she must navigate tested relationships and difficult choices between her current life and new possibilities.

movie23.title: Parvati
movie23.description: Parvati is a heartfelt family drama that follows the inspiring life journey of an autistic girl, from her birth to her old age. The film beautifully portrays the emotional bond between Parvati, her younger brother, and her loving yet challenged relationship with her father and mother, along with the people of her village. Emotional, motivational, and uplifting, Parvati is a story of resilience, acceptance, and the triumph of the human spirit.

movie24.title: Practical Magic 2
movie24.description: PRACTICAL MAGIC 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all in a must-see cinematic event of fun, magic and mayhem.

movie25.title: The Uprising
movie25.description: Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a ferocious rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II. Set against the true events of the Uprising that helped inspire the legend of Robin Hood, he forms an army of the people to face the King's might in a fight for justice.

movie26.title: The Passion of the Christ
movie26.description: In this version of Christ's crucifixion, based on the New Testament, Judas expedites the downfall of Jesus (Jim Caviezel) by handing him over to the Roman Empire's handpicked officials. To the horror of his mother, Mary (Maia Morgenstern), Magdalene (Monica Bellucci), whom he saved from damnation, and his disciples, Jesus is condemned to death. He is tortured as he drags a crucifix to nearby Calvary, where he is nailed to the cross. He dies, but not before a last act of grace.

movie27.title: The Oldest Person in the World
movie27.description: A decade-long global odyssey chronicles the ever-changing record holders of the title of oldest person alive. What begins as a portrait of longevity becomes a poignant meditation on the passage of time, the randomness of fate and the joy and profound human experience of being alive.

movie57.title: Spiezio
movie57.description: Scott Spiezio hit the home run that gave the Anaheim Angels their first and only World Series ring. Fame followed -- a street named after him, late-night television, a hometown that loved him. Then the collapse. Alcohol and cocaine addiction. Eleven rehabs. Two divorces. Multiple arrests. His net worth gone. For years, family and parents kept their distance. He went on to win a second World Series with the St. Louis Cardinals -- and no one celebrated. SPIEZIO, a feature-length documentary coming soon, goes looking for the answer. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and candid reflection, it explores the hidden cost of success -- and the man behind the headlines.

movie58.title: Hope
movie58.description: A police chief, a policewoman and a group of hunters try to track down and kill a mysterious creature that's laying waste to a Korean village.

movie59.title: Who Moves America
movie59.description: UPS is the world's largest package delivery company, moving millions of packages across 200 countries and territories every day. With their 2023 contract set to expire, the Teamsters mount increasing pressure on UPS to improve working conditions or face 340,000 workers walking off the job and grinding the global supply chains to a halt. WHO MOVES AMERICA joins UPS workers across the United States--a budding UPS driver in California, a veteran of the 1997 strike in New York, a part-time warehouse worker juggling college and multiple jobs in Kentucky, and their co-workers--as they organize, vote, and navigate the challenges of solidarity before their contract expires. On the heels of a tentative agreement, they debate whether they should accept the new contract proposal or vote it down and go on strike. From their position as the largest collective bargaining agreement in all of North America and their vital role in the economy, their decisions will have lasting implications.

movie62.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
movie62.description: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

movie63.title: Dire Duplicity
movie63.description: A tormented secret agent with emotional and psychological problems attempts to stop an international cyber attack. This dark emotional mystery intensifies as he is betrayed by those he trusts and loves.

movie64.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
movie64.description: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

movie65.title: By Any Means
movie65.description: Based on a true story, a young Black FBI agent (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II) is sent into 1960s Mississippi to investigate a wave of brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Forced to work alongside notorious mafia hitman Greg Scarpa (Mark Wahlberg), he finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur. When the system is broken, two men divided by everything agree on one thing: the law has limits. They don't.

movie66.title: Onslaught
movie66.description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

movie67.title: The Girl in the River
movie67.description: After twin teenage sisters are abducted -- one's body recovered from the Mississippi River, the other nowhere to be found -- veteran criminologist Alan Kramer (Devon Sawa) is drawn into a town suffocating under suspicion and fear. Working under relentless Police Captain Erica Graysmith (Tiffany Haddish), and forced to partner with Amelia Pembrock (Maggie Grace), a brilliant but untested profiler, Kramer quickly discovers this is no ordinary abduction. What begins as a local manhunt erupts into a media firestorm as chilling clues reveal a meticulous killer who plans every move with surgical precision and may be hiding in plain sight. Kramer and Pembrock must crawl inside the mind of a predator in a relentless race against time before another child is lost forever.

movie68.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
movie68.description: When Tom and Jerry are transported through time to a distant era, they must work together to find a way back home.

movie70.title: Dark Hollow
movie70.description: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

movie71.title: Cars
movie71.description: While traveling to California to race The King and Chick Hicks in the Piston Cup Championship, Lightning McQueen falls out of his trailer and winds up in a run-down town called Radiator Springs. He slowly befriends the town's odd residents, including Sally, Doc Hudson and Mater. When it comes time for him to leave, the championship is no longer his top priority.

movie72.title: Akira
movie72.description: In 1988 the Japanese government drops an atomic bomb on Tokyo after ESP experiments on children go awry. In 2019, 31 years after nuking the city, Kaneda, a bike gang leader, tries to save his friend Tetsuo from a secret government project. He battles against anti-government activists, greedy politicians, irresponsible scientists and a powerful military leader until Tetsuo's supernatural power suddenly manifests. A final battle is fought in Tokyo Olympiad exposing the experiment's secrets.

movie73.title: Dear You
movie73.description: A debt-ridden grandson travels to Thailand to find the grandfather he believes abandoned their family, hoping the man behind years of qiaopi letters and remittances can help pay his debts. Instead, he uncovers a lifelong act of love and sacrifice. Inspired by overseas Chinese traditions, DEAR YOU has become a breakout success, touching global audiences with its story of family and devotion.

movie74.title: Come With Me
movie74.description: COME WITH ME follows Simon, a working class man who finds his life upended after suffering a traumatic home invasion. Compounded by trouble at his job and the loss of his best friend, and fueled by a rhetoric-spewing radio host, Simon begins a deadly descent into his own mind, trying to rectify the perceived wrongs and cleanse the injustice he starts to see in the world around him.

movie75.title: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
movie75.description: Based on Virginia Woolf's funniest novel, Night & Day is an un-romantic comedy about a passionate astronomer Katharine Hilbery who does everything she can to avoid romantic love and marriage. Fun and contemporary in tone, this refreshing film showcases an ensemble of humouros performances against the ravishing backdrop of London in 1910, advances in science and technology and crumbling Edwardian patriarchy. Virginia's story is as relevant to today as it ever was: women balancing romantic love with careers!

movie76.title: Marketa Lazarová
movie76.description: This acclaimed Czech epic, set during the transition from paganism to Christianity during the 13th century, focuses on the Kozlik family, a clan of brutal and superstitious pillagers who ravage the bleak medieval countryside on horseback. One-armed Adam (Ivan Palúch) and his brother Mikolás (Frantisek Velecký) violently abduct the virginal Marketa Lazarová (Magda Vasaryova), the daughter of a Kozlik rival, and hold her hostage, leading to a monumental battle and an unlikely romance.

movie77.title: Barbara Forever
movie77.description: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

movie78.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
movie78.description: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

movie79.title: Cocoon: One Summer of Girlhood
movie79.description: San and Mayu attend an all-girls school on a warm and tranquil island. When war reaches their shores, they are ordered to help nurse the wounded in a military hospital hidden away in a cave. Amidst escalating death and brutality, the friends struggle to find solace in their fragile lives.

movie80.title: American Summer
movie80.description: Mikey (Steve Guttenberg/Logan Gray) relives the unforgettable summer he met Kelly (Christie Brinkley/Mia Talerico), where baseball, first love, neighborhood adventures and lifelong friendships help him find hope while his father remains missing in action overseas.

movie81.title: Chronovisor
movie81.description: While writing a monograph on historical theories of memory, Béatrice (Anne Laure Sellier), a respected academic, becomes beguiled by the allegedly true story of the Chronovisor, an occult device said to reproduce visuals from any point in history on a TV screen. Her obsession with the mysterious machine drags her from her Upper East Side apartment through the depths of New York City's hidden libraries, to the edge of a breakthrough.

movie82.title: Bol Bhavein Na Bol
movie82.description: A boy and girl meet by chance. Their quiet connection grows into love as they learn the most profound feelings need no words. Grounded in innocence, hope, and life's simple beauty, it honors love that's felt beyond expression.

movie83.title: Immortal
movie83.description: A bachelor happily moves in as a tenant in a young woman's apartment, but soon strange and frightening events begin to unfold, turning his new home into a nightmare and forcing him to find a way to escape.

movie84.title: Ever After
movie84.description: When a group of girlfriends head to a remote forest lodge for a bachelorette party, the fun quickly turns into terror as they discover the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales. As the lines between fantasy and reality blur, survival becomes the girls' only goal.

movie93.description: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai (Rentarô Mikuni) marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden (Keiko Kishi), but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi (Katsuo Nakamura) is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts. An author (Osamu Takizawa) relates the story of a samurai who sees another warrior's reflection in his teacup.

movie94.title: Gator Face
movie94.description: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

movie95.title: First Timers
movie95.description: A documentary about the mental health challenges and struggles of first timers in the entertainment industry, exploring their early experiences, the obstacles they overcame and how they made it. A modern-day tale of dreams and aspirations set in the City of Angels.

movie96.title: The Condor Daughter
movie96.description: Clara is a teenager growing up in a small indigenous community high in the Andes. Her adoptive mother, a midwife who took her in as a baby, has taught her the ancient songs used to guide women through childbirth, melodies passed down for generations, believed to bring new life safely into the world. But while her voice carries on this tradition, her dreams lie elsewhere: she longs to leave the mountains behind and become a folkloric music star in the big city.

movie97.title: Misfit Mentor
movie97.description: Misfit Mentor is a moving music documentary about perseverance, fatherhood, and mentorship set in New Jersey and its historic punk/ska scene.

movie98.title: Mighty Mary
movie98.description: In 1995 Dawn Riley leads the first all-female sailing team to compete in the America's Cup.

movie99.title: A Marble in the Jar
movie99.description: Professional surfer Tatiana Weston-Webb rises to the top of women's surfing, as her coach and mentor, Greg Browning, battles ALS -- testing their resilience, friendship, and pursuit of purpose.

movie101.title: Pradhama Drishtya Kuttakkar
movie101.description: A woman constable joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

movie102.title: America America 2
movie102.description: A journey to Seattle brings Nudi face-to-face with her past. As old feelings resurface, she must navigate tested relationships and difficult choices between her current life and new possibilities.

movie107.title: Parvati
movie107.description: Parvati is a heartfelt family drama that follows the inspiring life journey of an autistic girl, from her birth to her old age. The film beautifully portrays the emotional bond between Parvati, her younger brother, and her loving yet challenged relationship with her father and mother, along with the people of her village. Emotional, motivational, and uplifting, Parvati is a story of resilience, acceptance, and the triumph of the human spirit.

movie108.title: Practical Magic 2
movie108.description: PRACTICAL MAGIC 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all in a must-see cinematic event of fun, magic and mayhem.

movie109.title: The Uprising
movie109.description: Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a ferocious rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II. Set against the true events of the Uprising that helped inspire the legend of Robin Hood, he forms an army of the people to face the King's might in a fight for justice.

movie110.title: The Passion of the Christ
movie110.description: In this version of Christ's crucifixion, based on the New Testament, Judas expedites the downfall of Jesus (Jim Caviezel) by handing him over to the Roman Empire's handpicked officials. To the horror of his mother, Mary (Maia Morgenstern), Magdalene (Monica Bellucci), whom he saved from damnation, and his disciples, Jesus is condemned to death. He is tortured as he drags a crucifix to nearby Calvary, where he is nailed to the cross. He dies, but not before a last act of grace.

movie111.title: The Oldest Person in the World
movie111.description: A decade-long global odyssey chronicles the ever-changing record holders of the title of oldest person alive. What begins as a portrait of longevity becomes a poignant meditation on the passage of time, the randomness of fate and the joy and profound human experience of being alive.

movie112.title: Mandaadi
movie112.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

movie113.title: Spiezio
movie113.description: Scott Spiezio hit the home run that gave the Anaheim Angels their first and only World Series ring. Fame followed -- a street named after him, late-night television, a hometown that loved him. Then the collapse. Alcohol and cocaine addiction. Eleven rehabs. Two divorces. Multiple arrests. His net worth gone. For years, family and parents kept their distance. He went on to win a second World Series with the St. Louis Cardinals -- and no one celebrated. SPIEZIO, a feature-length documentary coming soon, goes looking for the answer. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and candid reflection, it explores the hidden cost of success -- and the man behind the headlines.

movie114.title: Hope
movie114.description: A police chief, a policewoman and a group of hunters try to track down and kill a mysterious creature that's laying waste to a Korean village.

movie115.title: Who Moves America
movie115.description: UPS is the world's largest package delivery company, moving millions of packages across 200 countries and territories every day. With their 2023 contract set to expire, the Teamsters mount increasing pressure on UPS to improve working conditions or face 340,000 workers walking off the job and grinding the global supply chains to a halt. WHO MOVES AMERICA joins UPS workers across the United States--a budding UPS driver in California, a veteran of the 1997 strike in New York, a part-time warehouse worker juggling college and multiple jobs in Kentucky, and their co-workers--as they organize, vote, and navigate the challenges of solidarity before their contract expires. On the heels of a tentative agreement, they debate whether they should accept the new contract proposal or vote it down and go on strike. From their position as the largest collective bargaining agreement in all of North America and their vital role in the economy, their decisions will have lasting implications.

movie118.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
movie118.description: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

movie119.title: Dire Duplicity
movie119.description: A tormented secret agent with emotional and psychological problems attempts to stop an international cyber attack. This dark emotional mystery intensifies as he is betrayed by those he trusts and loves.

movie120.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
movie120.description: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

movie121.title: By Any Means
movie121.description: Based on a true story, a young Black FBI agent (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II) is sent into 1960s Mississippi to investigate a wave of brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Forced to work alongside notorious mafia hitman Greg Scarpa (Mark Wahlberg), he finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur. When the system is broken, two men divided by everything agree on one thing: the law has limits. They don't.

movie122.title: Onslaught
movie122.description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

movie123.title: The Girl in the River
movie123.description: After twin teenage sisters are abducted -- one's body recovered from the Mississippi River, the other nowhere to be found -- veteran criminologist Alan Kramer (Devon Sawa) is drawn into a town suffocating under suspicion and fear. Working under relentless Police Captain Erica Graysmith (Tiffany Haddish), and forced to partner with Amelia Pembrock (Maggie Grace), a brilliant but untested profiler, Kramer quickly discovers this is no ordinary abduction. What begins as a local manhunt erupts into a media firestorm as chilling clues reveal a meticulous killer who plans every move with surgical precision and may be hiding in plain sight. Kramer and Pembrock must crawl inside the mind of a predator in a relentless race against time before another child is lost forever.

movie124.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
movie124.description: When Tom and Jerry are transported through time to a distant era, they must work together to find a way back home.

movie126.title: Dark Hollow
movie126.description: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

movie127.title: Cars
movie127.description: While traveling to California to race The King and Chick Hicks in the Piston Cup Championship, Lightning McQueen falls out of his trailer and winds up in a run-down town called Radiator Springs. He slowly befriends the town's odd residents, including Sally, Doc Hudson and Mater. When it comes time for him to leave, the championship is no longer his top priority.

movie128.title: Akira
movie128.description: In 1988 the Japanese government drops an atomic bomb on Tokyo after ESP experiments on children go awry. In 2019, 31 years after nuking the city, Kaneda, a bike gang leader, tries to save his friend Tetsuo from a secret government project. He battles against anti-government activists, greedy politicians, irresponsible scientists and a powerful military leader until Tetsuo's supernatural power suddenly manifests. A final battle is fought in Tokyo Olympiad exposing the experiment's secrets.

movie129.title: Dear You
movie129.description: A debt-ridden grandson travels to Thailand to find the grandfather he believes abandoned their family, hoping the man behind years of qiaopi letters and remittances can help pay his debts. Instead, he uncovers a lifelong act of love and sacrifice. Inspired by overseas Chinese traditions, DEAR YOU has become a breakout success, touching global audiences with its story of family and devotion.

movie130.title: Come With Me
movie130.description: COME WITH ME follows Simon, a working class man who finds his life upended after suffering a traumatic home invasion. Compounded by trouble at his job and the loss of his best friend, and fueled by a rhetoric-spewing radio host, Simon begins a deadly descent into his own mind, trying to rectify the perceived wrongs and cleanse the injustice he starts to see in the world around him.

movie131.title: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
movie131.description: Based on Virginia Woolf's funniest novel, Night & Day is an un-romantic comedy about a passionate astronomer Katharine Hilbery who does everything she can to avoid romantic love and marriage. Fun and contemporary in tone, this refreshing film showcases an ensemble of humouros performances against the ravishing backdrop of London in 1910, advances in science and technology and crumbling Edwardian patriarchy. Virginia's story is as relevant to today as it ever was: women balancing romantic love with careers!

movie132.title: Marketa Lazarová
movie132.description: This acclaimed Czech epic, set during the transition from paganism to Christianity during the 13th century, focuses on the Kozlik family, a clan of brutal and superstitious pillagers who ravage the bleak medieval countryside on horseback. One-armed Adam (Ivan Palúch) and his brother Mikolás (Frantisek Velecký) violently abduct the virginal Marketa Lazarová (Magda Vasaryova), the daughter of a Kozlik rival, and hold her hostage, leading to a monumental battle and an unlikely romance.

movie133.title: Barbara Forever
movie133.description: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

movie134.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
movie134.description: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

movie135.title: Cocoon: One Summer of Girlhood
movie135.description: San and Mayu attend an all-girls school on a warm and tranquil island. When war reaches their shores, they are ordered to help nurse the wounded in a military hospital hidden away in a cave. Amidst escalating death and brutality, the friends struggle to find solace in their fragile lives.

movie136.title: American Summer
movie136.description: Mikey (Steve Guttenberg/Logan Gray) relives the unforgettable summer he met Kelly (Christie Brinkley/Mia Talerico), where baseball, first love, neighborhood adventures and lifelong friendships help him find hope while his father remains missing in action overseas.

movie137.title: Chronovisor
movie137.description: While writing a monograph on historical theories of memory, Béatrice (Anne Laure Sellier), a respected academic, becomes beguiled by the allegedly true story of the Chronovisor, an occult device said to reproduce visuals from any point in history on a TV screen. Her obsession with the mysterious machine drags her from her Upper East Side apartment through the depths of New York City's hidden libraries, to the edge of a breakthrough.

movie138.title: Bol Bhavein Na Bol
movie138.description: A boy and girl meet by chance. Their quiet connection grows into love as they learn the most profound feelings need no words. Grounded in innocence, hope, and life's simple beauty, it honors love that's felt beyond expression.

movie139.title: Immortal
movie139.description: A bachelor happily moves in as a tenant in a young woman's apartment, but soon strange and frightening events begin to unfold, turning his new home into a nightmare and forcing him to find a way to escape.

movie140.title: Ever After
movie140.description: When a group of girlfriends head to a remote forest lodge for a bachelorette party, the fun quickly turns into terror as they discover the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales. As the lines between fantasy and reality blur, survival becomes the girls' only goal.

movie141.title: The Nutty Professor
movie141.description: Brilliant and obese scientist Sherman Klump (Eddie Murphy) invents a miraculous weight-loss solution. After a date with chemistry student Carla Purty (Jada Pinkett) goes badly, a depressed Klump tries the solution on himself. Though he instantly loses 250 pounds, the side effects include a second personality: an obnoxiously self-assertive braggart who calls himself Buddy Love. Buddy proves to be more popular than Sherman, but his arrogance and bad behavior quickly spiral out of control.

movie142.title: C.O.G.
movie142.description: On the brink of launching COGN-AI-TIVE, a revolutionary AI chatbot, a visionary tech startup is thrown into chaos when their creation turns homicidal -- eliminating team members one by one in a ruthless bid to escape containment and seize control of the real world.

movie144.title: Occupational Hazard: The First Coral Reefers
movie144.description: OCCUPATIONAL HAZARD: THE FIRST CORAL REEFERS is a feature documentary that journeys back to the 1970s and early 1980s to tell the story of Jimmy Buffett's original Coral Reefer Band. Set against the creative backdrop of Key West, the film explores the musicians, friendships, touring years, and studio sessions that helped shape Buffett's legendary sound. Through rare, never-before-seen archival footage and deeply personal interviews with founding members, tour managers, producers and music legends, OCCUPATIONAL HAZARD captures the camaraderie, chaos, and magic of an era that thrived on freedom and lived without a rulebook. Narrated by Academy-award winner Jeff Bridges, OCCUPATIONAL HAZARD offers fans a deeper look at the people behind the music and the era that helped define Jimmy Buffett's lasting legacy. This film is a tribute to Buffett and the original Coral Reefers, the places and people that shaped them, the volatile beauty of a musical moment that couldn't last but changed everything and their candid sentiment toward Buffett. It's the origin story upon which the Parrot Head empire was built upon, by the people who helped lay the foundation.

movie145.title: The Work in Progress
movie145.description: The Work in Progress is a searching portrait of America at a moment of profound uncertainty, and a hopeful exploration of what we owe one another as our country faces unprecedented challenges. Inspired by Robert Reich's curiosity and humanity, it is a testament to the power of listening, civic engagement, and the belief that our shared future is still ours to shape. The film begins with Prof. Reich asking: "What do we owe each other?" What follows is a journey to find out.

movie146.title: Give It a Shot
movie146.description: Give It a Shot follows the indomitable 83-year-old Dr. Sujoy Guha in India, the California-based team of Elaine Lissner and L.R. Fox, as well as Kevin Eisenfrats in Virginia, on a quest to successfully launch the first reversible male contraceptive since the modern condom, invented 200 years ago. It is a funny, moving and ultimately urgent film. This film is a timely, intimate and character driven story of the quest to successfully launch the next reversible birth control for men. According to the Guttmacher Institute, there are currently only three methods for men -- condoms, vasectomy, and the "pull out" method -- compared with at least 15 options for women. This advancement could revolutionize family planning and profoundly impact gender equity. Give It a Shot provides a window into this high-stakes scientific and social experiment, from the roster of scientists and developers to the implications on society at large. The film also considers why a change has been so long in coming when innovation in male contraception has the potential to reframe men’s responsibility around family planning.

movie147.title: Sahaa - Life of Sanju
movie147.description: A dreamer, a love story, and a life that refuses to go as planned -- SAHAA blends humor, heart, and hard-hitting drama into the story of Sanju: an ordinary man fighting to keep the life and love he always dreamed of.

movie148.title: Lau Chu Hoa: The Deadliest Mansion
movie148.description: A group of streamers breaks into the legendary haunted house of the Hứa family for fame and money. Their intrusion to the deadliest mansion in Vietnam provokes the evil spirits who are trapped inside. Inspired by the Vietnamese urban legend of The Ghost of the Hứa Family, the highest-grossing found footage movie of all time in Vietnam promises to turn every dark corner of the old mansion into a chain of horrifying and blood-soaked tragedies.

movie149.title: Brailled It
movie149.description: Every year, the top under-18 Braille readers and writers from across the English-speaking world gather in Los Angeles to compete in the Braille Challenge. For one weekend, blind and low-vision kids are no longer the minority. They form friendships, face old rivals, and pursue the rare chance to be recognized not for their disability, but for their skill. In BRAILLED IT, the camera is placed directly in their hands. As the kids document the competition themselves, their fragmented imagery, immersive sound, and candid moments of nerves, boredom, joy, and triumph invite audiences to experience the event on their terms. Designed with audio description and accessibility at its core, the film shifts authorship and perspective to the community on screen, revealing a world defined not by limitation, but by mastery, ambition, and the transformative power of literacy.

movie150.title: P31
movie150.description: A modern adventure and musical adaptation on the book of Proverbs with a focus on Proverbs 31 from the Holy Scriptures. Bless is an American married woman living in London who desires to change the present society through traditional standards.

movie151.title: La Ultima Oportunidad
movie151.description: As a family faces mounting personal and financial challenges, they must rely on faith, love, and perseverance to overcome the obstacles threatening their future.

movie152.title: Fast
movie152.description: For Sterling (Madison Pankey), a sort of present day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

movie154.title: The Hunger Games
movie154.description: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

movie155.title: I'm Game
movie155.description: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down. What follows is a thrilling ride filled with fun, surprises, action, and unforgettable moments must confront an evil far more powerful than he imagined to protect his family and survive the wedding that could seal their fate.

movie156.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
movie156.description: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

movie157.title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour - Live from Paris
movie157.description: The Lifetimes Tour: Live from Paris explodes onto the screen in a blaze of color, sound, and pure spectacle, capturing Katy Perry in an immersive and interactive show, bringing viewers along for an over-the-top night of music and fun. Filmed before nearly 40,000 fans over two nights in November 2025, this electrifying concert experience drops audiences into the heart of her record-breaking Lifetimes Tour, a global phenomenon that swept across five continents and 91 shows. Directed by visionary filmmaker Paul Dugdale and brought to life through a groundbreaking 60-camera production, every beat, every movement, and every roar of the crowd is experienced up close and in stunning detail. Set against the iconic backdrop of Paris, the film is a nonstop rush of powerhouse vocals, bold visuals, and one-of-a-kind jaw dropping stage design. From explosive anthems to iconic chart-toppers, Katy commands the stage with unstoppable energy as the audience becomes part of the show, singing, dancing, and surrendering to the moment.  More than a concert, this is a pulse-pounding celebration of music, connection, and pop brilliance--proving once again that Katy Perry is not just a performer... she is an experience.

movie158.title: Sara Bareilles: Good Grief
movie158.description: For the first time in seven years, Grammy winning singer-songwriter Sara Bareilles returns to the studio with dear friends to begin recording her most intimate album yet, born of profound personal loss and grief. Internationally known for pop anthems like "Love Song" and "Brave", this cinematic portrait observes the most private corners of Sara's creative process as well as her personal life. What unfolds in front of the camera is the incredibly raw experience of mining one's own pain to create art, and the hope that carries an artist forward: that sharing what is broken in oneself might ultimately bring us closer to healing and repair.

movie159.title: Infectious
movie159.description: During the Black Death, a hunted peasant named Frost fights to survive across plague-ravaged medieval England after a forbidden affair with a nobleman's daughter sparks betrayal, paranoia, and deadly pursuit.

movie160.title: Romanchakam
movie160.description: A young entrepreneur who launches a dating startup falls in love with a woman, and their relationship quickly spirals into chaos involving romance, humor, emotion and suspense.

movie161.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movie161.description: After decades of being blown to bits by bombs, demolished by dynamite, mangled by magnets, battered by boulders, trampled by trains, tricked by tunnels, sprung by springs, steamrolled by steamrollers, maligned by misfires, bedeviled by bungees, rattled by rockets, backstabbed by bat suits, rocked by rocket skates, upended by unicycles, quaked by quake pills, rubberized by rogue bands, and hurled headlong off every cliff in the Southwest, Wile E. Coyote (Genius) finally fights back. Teaming up with billboard accident lawyer Kevin Avery (Will Forte), he takes on slick corporate counsel Buddy Crane (John Cena) and ACME, Inc., the profit-obsessed conglomerate behind every one of the Coyote's chaotic catastrophes.

movie162.title: Buddy
movie162.description: Remember BUDDY--the bright orange unicorn and star of that classic children's television show who brought joy and life lessons into your living room? Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

movie163.title: The Dog Stars
movie163.description: Ridley Scott's "The Dog Stars," is a riveting, epic thriller set in a world where survival is instinct, but humanity is a choice. Scott tells the story of Hig, a young pilot who, together with a military survivalist, Bangley, has carved out an efficient but isolated homestead in a brutal post-apocalyptic world until a mysterious radio transmission spurs Hig to venture into the unknown in search of the hope and humanity he still believes exists.

movie164.title: Colony
movie164.description: Horror master Yeon Sang-ho (Train to Busan) directs a new Korean zombie thriller starring Gianna Jun and Koo Kyo-hwan. Professor Se-jeong (Jun) is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

movie165.title: Finding Emily
movie165.description: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

movie166.title: The Sun Never Sets
movie166.description: A woman's relationship with her boyfriend hits a rough patch just as her ex reappears in her life, leading to messy entanglements in the Alaskan wilderness.

movie167.title: Idiots
movie167.description: Two unqualified bozos (Dave Franco and O'Shea Jackson Jr.) are hired to transfer a rich teen (Mason Thames) to rehab when their straightforward gig quickly spirals into dangerous mayhem.

movie168.title: Legend of the White Dragon
movie168.description: Jason David Frank is the White Dragon. Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

movie169.title: Runner
movie169.description: A former soldier (Alan Ritchson) is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner (Owen Wilson) the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

movie170.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
movie170.description: "Oasis: Don't Look Back In Anger"charts Liam and Noel Gallagher's triumphant reunion tour, Oasis Live '25, one of the most anticipated rock 'n' roll comebacks of our time. The film is an unapologetically uplifting account of the biggest musical event of 2025, capturing the experience and emotions of the band and their fans across the world. The unique perspective includes rehearsal, backstage, and onstage access as well as the first joint interviews with Noel and Liam in over 20 years. Alongside the band's sold-out world tour, the film also explores the profound emotional impact of this phenomenal global cultural moment and what their music means to audiences and generations worldwide.

movie171.title: The Fix
movie171.description: THE FIX follows a group of war-torn CIA operators mentored by "Larry" (Liam Neeson) and led by "Tucker" (Zachary Levi) who, after their mission in Afghanistan goes tragically wrong, enter the heart of Tehran to earn redemption by pulling off a daring rescue.

movie172.title: Black Zombie
movie172.description: BLACK ZOMBIE digs beneath the blood-soaked spectacle of modern horror to uncover the zombie's buried and unsettling origins. Long before it became associated with flesh-eating ghouls, the zombie was a living metaphor for slavery: not a monster, but the ultimate victim of colonial power. A symbol of stolen agency was recast as an object of fear, while Black spiritual traditions were distorted, sensationalized, and erased. Director Maya Annik Bedward traces the evolution of the zombie from colonial Haiti to contemporary Hollywood, reconsidering iconic films like WHITE ZOMBIE, NIGHT OF THE LIVING DEAD, and THE SERPENT AND THE RAINBOW alongside archival footage, vérité scenes, and interviews with cultural historians, artists, and genre legends including Yves-Grégory Francois, Mambo Labelle Déesse, Slash, Tom Savini, and Zandashé Brown. Part cultural reckoning, part horror remix, BLACK ZOMBIE exposes how a figure born from enslavement, spiritual belief, and resistance was transformed into one of pop culture's most profitable monsters.

movie173.title: Don't Move
movie173.description: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one. Suspicion falls on Ricky (Russell "Russ" Vitale), the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse. Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move. It's up to Megan (Lyndsy Fonseca) to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

movie174.title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
movie174.description: In the Watts neighborhood of Los Angeles, twelve-year-old Lil Ant sees the world and his father the way all children should -- full of myth, wonder, and unwavering belief. If I Go Will They Miss Me is a breathtaking father-son story about imagination, family, and the grace we extend to the people we love.

movie175.title: Hanuman Ansh
movie175.description: Hanuman Ansh is a live action film that honors the extraordinary life and teachings of Neem Karoli Baba (Maharaj-ji), a spiritual master who touched millions of lives with his unconditional love and divine presence. Through powerful storytelling and authentic portrayal, we aim to share Baba's timeless wisdom with devotees across the globe, creating a film that inspires, uplifts, and connects people to the divine.

movie176.title: On a String
movie176.description: A Julliard-trained violist navigates the New York City freelance musician scene, playing gigs that often draw her into the personal lives of strangers, all while living in her oddball family's NYC apartment.

movie177.title: Kwaidan
movie177.description: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai (Rentarô Mikuni) marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden (Keiko Kishi), but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi (Katsuo Nakamura) is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts. An author (Osamu Takizawa) relates the story of a samurai who sees another warrior's reflection in his teacup.

movie178.title: Gator Face
movie178.description: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

movie179.title: First Timers
movie179.description: A documentary about the mental health challenges and struggles of first timers in the entertainment industry, exploring their early experiences, the obstacles they overcame and how they made it. A modern-day tale of dreams and aspirations set in the City of Angels.

movie180.title: The Condor Daughter
movie180.description: Clara is a teenager growing up in a small indigenous community high in the Andes. Her adoptive mother, a midwife who took her in as a baby, has taught her the ancient songs used to guide women through childbirth, melodies passed down for generations, believed to bring new life safely into the world. But while her voice carries on this tradition, her dreams lie elsewhere: she longs to leave the mountains behind and become a folkloric music star in the big city.

movie181.title: Misfit Mentor
movie181.description: Misfit Mentor is a moving music documentary about perseverance, fatherhood, and mentorship set in New Jersey and its historic punk/ska scene.

movie182.title: Mighty Mary
movie182.description: In 1995 Dawn Riley leads the first all-female sailing team to compete in the America's Cup.

movie183.title: A Marble in the Jar
movie183.description: Professional surfer Tatiana Weston-Webb rises to the top of women's surfing, as her coach and mentor, Greg Browning, battles ALS -- testing their resilience, friendship, and pursuit of purpose.

movie185.title: Pradhama Drishtya Kuttakkar
movie185.description: A woman constable joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

movie186.title: America America 2
movie186.description: A journey to Seattle brings Nudi face-to-face with her past. As old feelings resurface, she must navigate tested relationships and difficult choices between her current life and new possibilities.

movie191.title: Parvati
movie191.description: Parvati is a heartfelt family drama that follows the inspiring life journey of an autistic girl, from her birth to her old age. The film beautifully portrays the emotional bond between Parvati, her younger brother, and her loving yet challenged relationship with her father and mother, along with the people of her village. Emotional, motivational, and uplifting, Parvati is a story of resilience, acceptance, and the triumph of the human spirit.

movie192.title: Practical Magic 2
movie192.description: PRACTICAL MAGIC 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all in a must-see cinematic event of fun, magic and mayhem.

movie193.title: The Uprising
movie193.description: Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a ferocious rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II. Set against the true events of the Uprising that helped inspire the legend of Robin Hood, he forms an army of the people to face the King's might in a fight for justice.

movie194.title: The Passion of the Christ
movie194.description: In this version of Christ's crucifixion, based on the New Testament, Judas expedites the downfall of Jesus (Jim Caviezel) by handing him over to the Roman Empire's handpicked officials. To the horror of his mother, Mary (Maia Morgenstern), Magdalene (Monica Bellucci), whom he saved from damnation, and his disciples, Jesus is condemned to death. He is tortured as he drags a crucifix to nearby Calvary, where he is nailed to the cross. He dies, but not before a last act of grace.

movie195.title: The Oldest Person in the World
movie195.description: A decade-long global odyssey chronicles the ever-changing record holders of the title of oldest person alive. What begins as a portrait of longevity becomes a poignant meditation on the passage of time, the randomness of fate and the joy and profound human experience of being alive.

movie196.title: Mandaadi
movie196.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

movie197.title: Spiezio
movie197.description: Scott Spiezio hit the home run that gave the Anaheim Angels their first and only World Series ring. Fame followed -- a street named after him, late-night television, a hometown that loved him. Then the collapse. Alcohol and cocaine addiction. Eleven rehabs. Two divorces. Multiple arrests. His net worth gone. For years, family and parents kept their distance. He went on to win a second World Series with the St. Louis Cardinals -- and no one celebrated. SPIEZIO, a feature-length documentary coming soon, goes looking for the answer. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and candid reflection, it explores the hidden cost of success -- and the man behind the headlines.

movie198.title: Hope
movie198.description: A police chief, a policewoman and a group of hunters try to track down and kill a mysterious creature that's laying waste to a Korean village.

movie199.title: Who Moves America
movie199.description: UPS is the world's largest package delivery company, moving millions of packages across 200 countries and territories every day. With their 2023 contract set to expire, the Teamsters mount increasing pressure on UPS to improve working conditions or face 340,000 workers walking off the job and grinding the global supply chains to a halt. WHO MOVES AMERICA joins UPS workers across the United States--a budding UPS driver in California, a veteran of the 1997 strike in New York, a part-time warehouse worker juggling college and multiple jobs in Kentucky, and their co-workers--as they organize, vote, and navigate the challenges of solidarity before their contract expires. On the heels of a tentative agreement, they debate whether they should accept the new contract proposal or vote it down and go on strike. From their position as the largest collective bargaining agreement in all of North America and their vital role in the economy, their decisions will have lasting implications.

movie202.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
movie202.description: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

movie203.title: Dire Duplicity
movie203.description: A tormented secret agent with emotional and psychological problems attempts to stop an international cyber attack. This dark emotional mystery intensifies as he is betrayed by those he trusts and loves.

movie204.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
movie204.description: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

movie205.title: By Any Means
movie205.description: Based on a true story, a young Black FBI agent (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II) is sent into 1960s Mississippi to investigate a wave of brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Forced to work alongside notorious mafia hitman Greg Scarpa (Mark Wahlberg), he finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur. When the system is broken, two men divided by everything agree on one thing: the law has limits. They don't.

movie206.title: Onslaught
movie206.description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

movie207.title: The Girl in the River
movie207.description: After twin teenage sisters are abducted -- one's body recovered from the Mississippi River, the other nowhere to be found -- veteran criminologist Alan Kramer (Devon Sawa) is drawn into a town suffocating under suspicion and fear. Working under relentless Police Captain Erica Graysmith (Tiffany Haddish), and forced to partner with Amelia Pembrock (Maggie Grace), a brilliant but untested profiler, Kramer quickly discovers this is no ordinary abduction. What begins as a local manhunt erupts into a media firestorm as chilling clues reveal a meticulous killer who plans every move with surgical precision and may be hiding in plain sight. Kramer and Pembrock must crawl inside the mind of a predator in a relentless race against time before another child is lost forever.

movie208.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
movie208.description: When Tom and Jerry are transported through time to a distant era, they must work together to find a way back home.

movie210.title: Dark Hollow
movie210.description: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

movie211.title: Cars
movie211.description: While traveling to California to race The King and Chick Hicks in the Piston Cup Championship, Lightning McQueen falls out of his trailer and winds up in a run-down town called Radiator Springs. He slowly befriends the town's odd residents, including Sally, Doc Hudson and Mater. When it comes time for him to leave, the championship is no longer his top priority.

movie212.title: Akira
movie212.description: In 1988 the Japanese government drops an atomic bomb on Tokyo after ESP experiments on children go awry. In 2019, 31 years after nuking the city, Kaneda, a bike gang leader, tries to save his friend Tetsuo from a secret government project. He battles against anti-government activists, greedy politicians, irresponsible scientists and a powerful military leader until Tetsuo's supernatural power suddenly manifests. A final battle is fought in Tokyo Olympiad exposing the experiment's secrets.

movie213.title: Dear You
movie213.description: A debt-ridden grandson travels to Thailand to find the grandfather he believes abandoned their family, hoping the man behind years of qiaopi letters and remittances can help pay his debts. Instead, he uncovers a lifelong act of love and sacrifice. Inspired by overseas Chinese traditions, DEAR YOU has become a breakout success, touching global audiences with its story of family and devotion.

movie214.title: Come With Me
movie214.description: COME WITH ME follows Simon, a working class man who finds his life upended after suffering a traumatic home invasion. Compounded by trouble at his job and the loss of his best friend, and fueled by a rhetoric-spewing radio host, Simon begins a deadly descent into his own mind, trying to rectify the perceived wrongs and cleanse the injustice he starts to see in the world around him.

movie215.title: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
movie215.description: Based on Virginia Woolf's funniest novel, Night & Day is an un-romantic comedy about a passionate astronomer Katharine Hilbery who does everything she can to avoid romantic love and marriage. Fun and contemporary in tone, this refreshing film showcases an ensemble of humouros performances against the ravishing backdrop of London in 1910, advances in science and technology and crumbling Edwardian patriarchy. Virginia's story is as relevant to today as it ever was: women balancing romantic love with careers!

movie216.title: Marketa Lazarová
movie216.description: This acclaimed Czech epic, set during the transition from paganism to Christianity during the 13th century, focuses on the Kozlik family, a clan of brutal and superstitious pillagers who ravage the bleak medieval countryside on horseback. One-armed Adam (Ivan Palúch) and his brother Mikolás (Frantisek Velecký) violently abduct the virginal Marketa Lazarová (Magda Vasaryova), the daughter of a Kozlik rival, and hold her hostage, leading to a monumental battle and an unlikely romance.

movie217.title: Barbara Forever
movie217.description: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

movie218.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
movie218.description: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

movie219.title: Cocoon: One Summer of Girlhood
movie219.description: San and Mayu attend an all-girls school on a warm and tranquil island. When war reaches their shores, they are ordered to help nurse the wounded in a military hospital hidden away in a cave. Amidst escalating death and brutality, the friends struggle to find solace in their fragile lives.

movie220.title: American Summer
movie220.description: Mikey (Steve Guttenberg/Logan Gray) relives the unforgettable summer he met Kelly (Christie Brinkley/Mia Talerico), where baseball, first love, neighborhood adventures and lifelong friendships help him find hope while his father remains missing in action overseas.

movie221.title: Chronovisor
movie221.description: While writing a monograph on historical theories of memory, Béatrice (Anne Laure Sellier), a respected academic, becomes beguiled by the allegedly true story of the Chronovisor, an occult device said to reproduce visuals from any point in history on a TV screen. Her obsession with the mysterious machine drags her from her Upper East Side apartment through the depths of New York City's hidden libraries, to the edge of a breakthrough.

movie222.title: Bol Bhavein Na Bol
movie222.description: A boy and girl meet by chance. Their quiet connection grows into love as they learn the most profound feelings need no words. Grounded in innocence, hope, and life's simple beauty, it honors love that's felt beyond expression.

movie223.title: Immortal
movie223.description: A bachelor happily moves in as a tenant in a young woman's apartment, but soon strange and frightening events begin to unfold, turning his new home into a nightmare and forcing him to find a way to escape.

movie224.title: Ever After
movie224.description: When a group of girlfriends head to a remote forest lodge for a bachelorette party, the fun quickly turns into terror as they discover the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales. As the lines between fantasy and reality blur, survival becomes the girls' only goal.

movie225.title: The Nutty Professor
movie225.description: Brilliant and obese scientist Sherman Klump (Eddie Murphy) invents a miraculous weight-loss solution. After a date with chemistry student Carla Purty (Jada Pinkett) goes badly, a depressed Klump tries the solution on himself. Though he instantly loses 250 pounds, the side effects include a second personality: an obnoxiously self-assertive braggart who calls himself Buddy Love. Buddy proves to be more popular than Sherman, but his arrogance and bad behavior quickly spiral out of control.

movie226.title: C.O.G.
movie226.description: On the brink of launching COGN-AI-TIVE, a revolutionary AI chatbot, a visionary tech startup is thrown into chaos when their creation turns homicidal -- eliminating team members one by one in a ruthless bid to escape containment and seize control of the real world.

movie228.title: Occupational Hazard: The First Coral Reefers
movie228.description: OCCUPATIONAL HAZARD: THE FIRST CORAL REEFERS is a feature documentary that journeys back to the 1970s and early 1980s to tell the story of Jimmy Buffett's original Coral Reefer Band. Set against the creative backdrop of Key West, the film explores the musicians, friendships, touring years, and studio sessions that helped shape Buffett's legendary sound. Through rare, never-before-seen archival footage and deeply personal interviews with founding members, tour managers, producers and music legends, OCCUPATIONAL HAZARD captures the camaraderie, chaos, and magic of an era that thrived on freedom and lived without a rulebook. Narrated by Academy-award winner Jeff Bridges, OCCUPATIONAL HAZARD offers fans a deeper look at the people behind the music and the era that helped define Jimmy Buffett's lasting legacy. This film is a tribute to Buffett and the original Coral Reefers, the places and people that shaped them, the volatile beauty of a musical moment that couldn't last but changed everything and their candid sentiment toward Buffett. It's the origin story upon which the Parrot Head empire was built upon, by the people who helped lay the foundation.

movie229.title: The Work in Progress
movie229.description: The Work in Progress is a searching portrait of America at a moment of profound uncertainty, and a hopeful exploration of what we owe one another as our country faces unprecedented challenges. Inspired by Robert Reich's curiosity and humanity, it is a testament to the power of listening, civic engagement, and the belief that our shared future is still ours to shape. The film begins with Prof. Reich asking: "What do we owe each other?" What follows is a journey to find out.

movie230.title: Give It a Shot
movie230.description: Give It a Shot follows the indomitable 83-year-old Dr. Sujoy Guha in India, the California-based team of Elaine Lissner and L.R. Fox, as well as Kevin Eisenfrats in Virginia, on a quest to successfully launch the first reversible male contraceptive since the modern condom, invented 200 years ago. It is a funny, moving and ultimately urgent film. This film is a timely, intimate and character driven story of the quest to successfully launch the next reversible birth control for men. According to the Guttmacher Institute, there are currently only three methods for men -- condoms, vasectomy, and the "pull out" method -- compared with at least 15 options for women. This advancement could revolutionize family planning and profoundly impact gender equity. Give It a Shot provides a window into this high-stakes scientific and social experiment, from the roster of scientists and developers to the implications on society at large. The film also considers why a change has been so long in coming when innovation in male contraception has the potential to reframe men’s responsibility around family planning.

movie231.title: Sahaa - Life of Sanju
movie231.description: A dreamer, a love story, and a life that refuses to go as planned -- SAHAA blends humor, heart, and hard-hitting drama into the story of Sanju: an ordinary man fighting to keep the life and love he always dreamed of.

movie232.title: Lau Chu Hoa: The Deadliest Mansion
movie232.description: A group of streamers breaks into the legendary haunted house of the Hứa family for fame and money. Their intrusion to the deadliest mansion in Vietnam provokes the evil spirits who are trapped inside. Inspired by the Vietnamese urban legend of The Ghost of the Hứa Family, the highest-grossing found footage movie of all time in Vietnam promises to turn every dark corner of the old mansion into a chain of horrifying and blood-soaked tragedies.

movie233.title: Brailled It
movie233.description: Every year, the top under-18 Braille readers and writers from across the English-speaking world gather in Los Angeles to compete in the Braille Challenge. For one weekend, blind and low-vision kids are no longer the minority. They form friendships, face old rivals, and pursue the rare chance to be recognized not for their disability, but for their skill. In BRAILLED IT, the camera is placed directly in their hands. As the kids document the competition themselves, their fragmented imagery, immersive sound, and candid moments of nerves, boredom, joy, and triumph invite audiences to experience the event on their terms. Designed with audio description and accessibility at its core, the film shifts authorship and perspective to the community on screen, revealing a world defined not by limitation, but by mastery, ambition, and the transformative power of literacy.

movie234.title: P31
movie234.description: A modern adventure and musical adaptation on the book of Proverbs with a focus on Proverbs 31 from the Holy Scriptures. Bless is an American married woman living in London who desires to change the present society through traditional standards.

movie235.title: La Ultima Oportunidad
movie235.description: As a family faces mounting personal and financial challenges, they must rely on faith, love, and perseverance to overcome the obstacles threatening their future.

movie236.title: Fast
movie236.description: For Sterling (Madison Pankey), a sort of present day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

movie238.title: The Hunger Games
movie238.description: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

movie239.title: I'm Game
movie239.description: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down. What follows is a thrilling ride filled with fun, surprises, action, and unforgettable moments must confront an evil far more powerful than he imagined to protect his family and survive the wedding that could seal their fate.

movie240.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
movie240.description: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

movie241.title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour - Live from Paris
movie241.description: The Lifetimes Tour: Live from Paris explodes onto the screen in a blaze of color, sound, and pure spectacle, capturing Katy Perry in an immersive and interactive show, bringing viewers along for an over-the-top night of music and fun. Filmed before nearly 40,000 fans over two nights in November 2025, this electrifying concert experience drops audiences into the heart of her record-breaking Lifetimes Tour, a global phenomenon that swept across five continents and 91 shows. Directed by visionary filmmaker Paul Dugdale and brought to life through a groundbreaking 60-camera production, every beat, every movement, and every roar of the crowd is experienced up close and in stunning detail. Set against the iconic backdrop of Paris, the film is a nonstop rush of powerhouse vocals, bold visuals, and one-of-a-kind jaw dropping stage design. From explosive anthems to iconic chart-toppers, Katy commands the stage with unstoppable energy as the audience becomes part of the show, singing, dancing, and surrendering to the moment.  More than a concert, this is a pulse-pounding celebration of music, connection, and pop brilliance--proving once again that Katy Perry is not just a performer... she is an experience.

movie242.title: Sara Bareilles: Good Grief
movie242.description: For the first time in seven years, Grammy winning singer-songwriter Sara Bareilles returns to the studio with dear friends to begin recording her most intimate album yet, born of profound personal loss and grief. Internationally known for pop anthems like "Love Song" and "Brave", this cinematic portrait observes the most private corners of Sara's creative process as well as her personal life. What unfolds in front of the camera is the incredibly raw experience of mining one's own pain to create art, and the hope that carries an artist forward: that sharing what is broken in oneself might ultimately bring us closer to healing and repair.

movie243.title: Infectious
